# GOBIN, GOPROXY, GOSUMDB and GOTOOLCHAIN are removed. None is a go command
# variable, so 'go env' does not report one and 'go env -w' refuses to store
# one.

go env GOBIN
! stdout .
go env GOPROXY
! stdout .
go env GOSUMDB
! stdout .
go env GOTOOLCHAIN
! stdout .

! go env -w GOBIN=$WORK/bin
stderr 'unknown go command variable GOBIN'
! go env -w GOPROXY=off
stderr 'unknown go command variable GOPROXY'
! go env -w GOSUMDB=off
stderr 'unknown go command variable GOSUMDB'
! go env -w GOTOOLCHAIN=path
stderr 'unknown go command variable GOTOOLCHAIN'

! go env -u GOBIN
stderr 'unknown go command variable GOBIN'
! go env -u GOPROXY
stderr 'unknown go command variable GOPROXY'
! go env -u GOSUMDB
stderr 'unknown go command variable GOSUMDB'
! go env -u GOTOOLCHAIN
stderr 'unknown go command variable GOTOOLCHAIN'

# None appears in the full listing.
go env
! stdout '(set )?GOBIN='
! stdout '(set )?GOPROXY='
! stdout '(set )?GOSUMDB='
! stdout '(set )?GOTOOLCHAIN='

go env -json
! stdout '"GOBIN"'
! stdout '"GOPROXY"'
! stdout '"GOSUMDB"'
! stdout '"GOTOOLCHAIN"'

# A value in the environment does not come back. The go command ignores it
# whatever it says.
env GOBIN=$WORK/bin
env GOPROXY=off
env GOSUMDB=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=path
env UNKNOWNVAR=carried
go env GOBIN
! stdout .
go env GOPROXY
! stdout .
go env GOSUMDB
! stdout .
go env GOTOOLCHAIN
! stdout .

# It still reaches a child process. A name this go command ignores travels the
# way an unknown name travels, because a build tool does not edit what the
# program under 'go run' sees.
go run printenv.go
stdout 'GOBIN='
stdout 'GOPROXY=off'
stdout 'GOSUMDB=off'
stdout 'GOTOOLCHAIN=path'
stdout 'UNKNOWNVAR=carried'

# An env file left behind by another toolchain does not set one either.
env GOBIN=
env GOPROXY=
env GOSUMDB=
env GOTOOLCHAIN=
env GOENV=$WORK/goenv
go env GOBIN
! stdout .
go env GOPROXY
! stdout .
go env GOSUMDB
! stdout .
go env GOTOOLCHAIN
! stdout .

-- $WORK/goenv --
GOBIN=/tmp/gobin
GOPROXY=https://goproxy.example.com
GOSUMDB=sum.example.com+key
GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.21.0
-- go.mod --
module printenv

go 1.16
-- printenv.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

// UNKNOWNVAR is the control. The go command knows nothing about it, so
// whatever reaches this program under that name is what a removed name must
// reach it as too.
func main() {
	for _, kv := range os.Environ() {
		for _, name := range []string{"GOBIN=", "GOPROXY=", "GOSUMDB=", "GOTOOLCHAIN=", "UNKNOWNVAR="} {
			if strings.HasPrefix(kv, name) {
				fmt.Println(kv)
			}
		}
	}
}
